question: What should be uttered fourteen times at the end of the tritāra root mantra?
premises: The location is the end of the tritāra root mantra.
The syllable vaṃ is to be uttered.
inference: One should utter the syllable vaṃ fourteen times at the end of the tritāra root mantra.
plain_english: Then at the end of the tritāra root mantra, one should say 'vaṃ' fourteen times.
